title: Campaign flow: menus, relocation fade, results, ending
acceptance: Full loop start -> L1 -> fade -> L2 -> ending -> results
description: Until real arenas exist (T-0020, T-0027), the flow runs in the code-built sandbox range: title panel, two short stand-in levels that complete when their waves are cleared, brief results, relocation fade, ending, campaign results, back to title. Menu buttons are world-space panels the player shoots. Widened to Core/Game (the sandbox game mode builds what each stage shows).

result.summary: Campaign flow on the game instance: Title -> L1 -> brief results -> relocation fade -> L2 -> ending -> campaign results -> title, plus practice. Shootable world-space menu panels. Results tracked (shots, hits, weak-point hits, brace-absorbed damage, retries, time), saved, provisional score. Until real arenas exist, both levels are short stand-in encounters in the sandbox range; the fade dims the range's only light; sun moved behind the rig so panels and enemies are lit.
result.verification: Editor build; all 83 ETM tests pass incl. 5 new ETM.Core.Flow tests (full loop with map loads, run tracking, sandbox stages/panels with a real cannon shot on START, stand-in levels finite); APK packaged and installed on Quest 3. Headset play-through by the owner pending.
result.remaining: Owner headset run of the full loop; text facing and readability on device; failure screen, pause-menu quit, continue-from-checkpoint on the title, interrupted-attack damage for P-30, real arena maps and a fade that works with baked lighting
